concepts.source_evidence: Measurement of 8 Time and Motion Prerna and her younger sister are watching a sports channel on television.

concepts.name: Evidence and reasoning
concepts.definition: Use source information, observation or valid working to support a conclusion.
concepts.source_evidence: Prerna enjoys running and she has been declared the fastest runner among the girls in her district for winning the 100 metre sprint at an interschool competition held at the district level.

concepts.name: Application and transfer
